controls.ntz_column: SELECT id, CAST(ntz AS STRING), typeof(ntz) FROM t ORDER BY id
controls.pyarrow_adjusted: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING), typeof(ts) FROM pa_adj ORDER BY id
controls.pyarrow_int96: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING), typeof(ts) FROM pa_int96 ORDER BY id
controls.pyarrow_naive: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING), typeof(ts) FROM pa_naive ORDER BY id
controls.self_join: SELECT a.id, b.id FROM t a JOIN t b ON a.ts = b.ts ORDER BY 1
controls.spark_micros: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING), typeof(ts) FROM mic ORDER BY id

iceberg_read: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING) FROM {table} ORDER BY id

pins.date_filter: SELECT id FROM t WHERE CAST(ts AS DATE) = DATE'2025-01-14' ORDER BY id
pins.group_by_date: SELECT CAST(to_date(ts) AS STRING) d, count(*) FROM t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
pins.hour: SELECT id, hour(ts) FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.join_micros: SELECT a.id, b.id FROM t a JOIN mic b ON a.ts = b.ts ORDER BY 1
pins.join_pyarrow_adjusted: SELECT a.id, b.id FROM t a JOIN pa_adj b ON a.ts = b.ts ORDER BY 1
pins.join_pyarrow_naive: SELECT a.id, b.id FROM t a JOIN pa_naive b ON a.ts = b.ts ORDER BY 1
pins.max_min: SELECT CAST(max(ts) AS STRING), CAST(min(ts) AS STRING), count(ts) FROM t
pins.mixed_directory: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING), typeof(ts) FROM mix ORDER BY id
pins.nested_array: SELECT id, CAST(a[1] AS STRING) FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.nested_map: SELECT id, CAST(m['k'] AS STRING) FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.nested_struct: SELECT id, CAST(s.t AS STRING) FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.range_filter: SELECT id FROM t WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP'2025-01-15 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP'2025-01-16 00:00:00' ORDER BY id
pins.str: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING) FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.to_date: SELECT id, CAST(to_date(ts) AS STRING) FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.ts_eq_ntz: SELECT id, ts = ntz FROM t ORDER BY id
pins.typeof: SELECT typeof(ts), typeof(ntz), typeof(s), typeof(a), typeof(m) FROM t LIMIT 1
pins.unix_timestamp: SELECT id, unix_timestamp(ts) FROM t ORDER BY id

write_read: SELECT id, CAST(ts AS STRING), CAST(s.t AS STRING) FROM w ORDER BY id
write_source: SELECT id, ts, s FROM t
